rejected.reason: Thin: cited sources are a 0-upvote thread and 2025 Reddit posts; high-engagement Bilibili buff reactions (31万/52万) were dismissive. Pro 2.5 approved instead.
The batch itself says he is still bottom-tier in 七阶/巅峰; S44 high-rank list and CN list (C) keep him last; buff optimism is 2025 and mid-rank.
Evidence on the Jul-2026 rework is split (429-like top comment calls it a nerf, 167-like says buff); kite 7 already above average.
Evidence is about low popularity, not strength: the 758-like consensus is 'actually strong but few play him'; verified COA VIII 50 uses (7th). Conflicts with the strength-based logic used elsewhere.
